id: 191_激光切割机操作（桌面与工业）
title: 激光切割机操作（桌面与工业）

points.K20: 切割头、压力表与格栅台

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台关着盖的桌面激光切割机旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed desktop laser cutter with a fume purifier underneath, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第二十九课：激光切割机操作。
overlay: 激光切割机操作（桌面与工业）

shots.scene: 阿杰在电脑上点了开始，起身准备走开
shots.prompt_en: The young male student clicks start on a laptop beside a desktop laser cutter, then stands up and turns to walk away, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰：点了开始，我去倒杯水。

shots.scene: 小研指着没开的净化器和机器上的启动键
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a switched off fume purifier and at the start button on the machine, a crossed out walking away icon.
shots.narration: 小研：净化器没开，人也不能走！

shots.scene: 王老师拿着操作流程卡走来
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks over holding a blank procedure card with numbered step icons.
shots.narration: 王老师：照流程一步步来。

shots.scene: 二氧化碳激光聚成小光点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a carbon dioxide laser beam focused by a lens into a tiny spot on a wooden board inside a closed machine. No text.
shots.narration: 桌面机用二氧化碳激光，聚成小光点。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plywood board and an acrylic sheet with checkmarks, a permitted material list icon beside them. No text.
shots.narration: 木板、亚克力等许可材料能加工。

shots.scene: 照片、拼图、小木盒、小尺子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an engraved photo on wood, a wooden puzzle, a small wooden box and a small ruler. No text.
shots.narration: 能雕照片，做拼图、木盒和小尺子。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser cutting fully through a board along the outline of a small badge. No text.
shots.narration: 切割，沿外框把整片切下来。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser engraving a filled name area, deeper and darker. No text.
shots.narration: 雕刻把图案填满，刻得较深。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser scoring thin shallow ruler marks on the surface. No text.
shots.narration: 划线只留浅浅一层灼痕。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small wooden badge ruler with an engraved name, scored scale marks and a cut outline. No text.
shots.narration: 第一个作品徽章尺，三种都用上。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laptop with a blank design canvas connected to a desktop laser cutter icon. No text.
shots.narration: 设计都在设计软件里完成。

shots.scene: 在家用个人账号提前设计
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a home desk with a laptop and a personal account icon, a design being prepared. No text.
shots.narration: 可以在自己电脑上用个人账号设计。

shots.scene: 公共电脑只用公共账号和免费设计
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab computer with a shared account icon, a free design checked and a paid design crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 公共电脑用公共账号，只用免费设计。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a logout icon, a personal data icon crossed out on the shared computer, a license icon on a shared design. No text.
shots.narration: 用完退出登录，遵守设计的许可。

shots.scene: 最近文件里有别人的设计
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a recent files list with designs of several users, a hand icon stopped before opening someone else's file. No text.
shots.narration: 最近文件里有别人的设计，别打开改。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shared folder visible to many user icons, a delete menu icon after finishing. No text.
shots.narration: 公共空间人人可见，不想公开就删除。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a design file saved from a home laptop onto a USB drive icon and a cloud icon. No text.
shots.narration: 在家做好，下载保存，带来上传。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an upload button importing a file onto the canvas, its process settings attached. No text.
shots.narration: 上传的文件会带着原来的加工设置。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gallery of shared designs with a search box icon and a detail card with material, preview and author icons. No text.
shots.narration: 现成设计可搜索，看材料预览作者。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a design made for an ultraviolet laser with a question mark beside a carbon dioxide machine, a resize arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 别的机型设计，可能要改尺寸改文件。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a design opened on the canvas, moved as a whole and one element adjusted separately. No text.
shots.narration: 打开到画布，可整体移也可单独调。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a design outline checked against the board size, a ruler icon and a checkmark. No text.
shots.narration: 加工前查文件：尺寸、在不在板内。

shots.scene: 查切雕划设置，删重复线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three process type icons checked, and two overlapping duplicate lines with a flame icon crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 切雕划设对没有，重复线要删掉。

shots.scene: 软件里能看到机内画面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laptop showing a live camera view of the machine bed with the design overlaid on the board. No text.
shots.narration: 软件里有机内实时画面，方便对位。

shots.scene: 两个绿点：设备和净化器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two green status dots, one for the laser cutter and one for the fume purifier. No text.
shots.narration: 切割机、净化器两个绿点都亮才行。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one grey status dot, a stop icon and a safety administrator icon being called. No text.
shots.narration: 缺一个机器不运行，请管理员检查。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: shapes in two colours, all shapes of one colour selected at once, a process icon unchanged. No text.
shots.narration: 颜色只用来分组选择，不影响加工。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a honeycomb panel mode icon checked, a slats removed mode icon for engraving on a thick object. No text.
shots.narration: 模式默认蜂窝板，厚物件雕刻拆板条。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the same design repeated many times on a board, and a variant with small differences. No text.
shots.narration: 做很多份，可以用批量加工。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an accessory icon in the software that the lab does not own, crossed out, an error icon. No text.
shots.narration: 场所没有的附件不要选。

shots.scene: 材料列表选材料和厚度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a material list with wood boards of two thicknesses, the matching thickness selected. No text.
shots.narration: 在列表选材料，厚度一定选对。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thick board with settings for a thin board, an incomplete cut and a scorched edge. No text.
shots.narration: 厚度选错，功率速度就都不对。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an apply button filling power and speed for each step, a hand raising the power crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 应用预设，不自行加大功率放慢速度。

shots.scene: 没有预设先做测试阵列
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a grid of small squares with power increasing along one side and speed along the other. No text.
shots.narration: 没有预设，用材料测试阵列找参数。

shots.scene: 切割测试：挑切透又干净的
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cut test grid on scrap wood, the cleanly cut through square circled. No text.
shots.narration: 切割测试，挑切透、边缘干净那格。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an engraving test row from light to dark, the preferred square circled. No text.
shots.narration: 雕刻测试，按深浅挑最合适那格。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a test piece on a scrap corner of the board before the full job, a checkmark. No text.
shots.narration: 新设计新材料，先在边角料试。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a photo image with only the engrave icon allowed, lines with score, engrave or cut options. No text.
shots.narration: 图片只能雕刻，线条可划可雕可切。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one engrave step adjusted deeper while the cut step keeps its default. No text.
shots.narration: 也可只调一个步骤，其他照旧。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: objects with the same settings merged into one step, the step order arranged automatically. No text.
shots.narration: 设置相同并成一步，顺序自动排。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a honeycomb panel seated flat on its rail holders, old debris removed, a clean lens icon. No text.
shots.narration: 蜂窝板放平放稳，清掉上次碎屑。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fume purifier icon, an emergency stop button and a closed lid, each with a checkmark. No text.
shots.narration: 排风正常，急停好用，盖板关得严。

shots.scene: 【实拍】打开机盖，木板放平，固定针压稳
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands placing a plywood board flat on a honeycomb panel of a powered off desktop laser cutter and pressing in hold down pins.
shots.narration: 木板平放，固定针插进蜂窝孔压稳。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the lid closed, a refresh button pressed and the live view updated to show the board. No text.
shots.narration: 关好机盖，点刷新才看到木板。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the laser head moving above the board and a camera icon measuring the distance automatically. No text.
shots.narration: 放好设计先测距，机器自动测距离。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand measuring the thickness of a plywood board with a caliper beside a powered off laser cutter.
shots.narration: 测不到就输入厚度，一定要量准。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an out of focus beam leaving an incomplete scorched cut, a warped board touching the head crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 焦点不准会烧焦，翘起的材料要压平。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ruler design imported on the canvas, a text tool adding a name above the scale. No text.
shots.narration: 导入刻度尺，用文字工具加名字。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the name changed from an outline score to a filled engrave. No text.
shots.narration: 名字从划线改成雕刻，把字填满。

shots.scene: 外偏移生成外框设为切割
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an outer offset line drawn around the ruler and set to cut, selected from the object list. No text.
shots.narration: 向外偏移生成外框，设为切割。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three steps listed, score, engrave and cut, and a material selection reopened. No text.
shots.narration: 三个步骤齐了，新文件要重选材料。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: designs placed row by row from the corner of a board instead of the centre. No text.
shots.narration: 从边角一行行排，省材料。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a three dimensional preview of the badge ruler with engraved name, scored marks and cut outline. No text.
shots.narration: 先看三维预览，确认效果。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an estimated time clock and a processing path, engraving first and cutting last. No text.
shots.narration: 看预计用时和路径，切割放最后。

shots.scene: 【实拍】先开净化器，风量指示到位
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand switching on a fume purifier and pressing its airflow button until the indicator lights reach the required level, laser not running.
shots.narration: 启动前先开净化器，风量调到要求。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a send arrow from a laptop to the machine, the machine waiting, a start button on the machine glowing. No text.
shots.narration: 软件点开始只是发送，按机器键才启动。

shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits next to a closed desktop laser cutter watching through its viewing window, a fire extinguisher nearby.
shots.narration: 关好盖按启动，坐在旁边看着。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small flame inside the closed machine, a hand pressing the pause button, the lid kept closed. No text.
shots.narration: 有火苗立即暂停，不开盖，报告老师。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a just finished badge and honeycomb panel with heat waves, a clock, then tweezers lifting the cooled piece. No text.
shots.narration: 作品和蜂窝板很烫，冷却后再取。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifier over the cut edge checking for embers, small fallen pieces picked out with tweezers. No text.
shots.narration: 看切边有没有火星，碎片夹出来。

shots.scene: 【实拍】冷却后清出碎屑倒入金属桶
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands brushing cooled scraps from a honeycomb panel of a powered off laser cutter into a metal bin.
shots.narration: 碎屑残渣倒进指定金属桶。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the fume purifier switched off after the job, tools returned, the bench tidy, a power off icon. No text.
shots.narration: 按规程关净化器，工具归位。

shots.prompt_en: The young male student completes the procedure himself while the safety administrator watches and ticks a checklist.
shots.narration: 看完演示，还要亲手做一遍。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an industrial fiber laser cutter with a closed protective enclosure cutting identical metal parts from a sheet. No text.
shots.narration: 工业机按图纸切出各种金属件。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stack of identical metal parts with matching holes, a small custom batch icon. No text.
shots.narration: 成批一致，也适合小批量定制。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser beam focused under a cutting head melting a narrow line in a steel sheet. No text.
shots.narration: 激光在切割头下聚成一点，熔化金属。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an assist gas jet blowing molten metal out of the kerf downward with sparks. No text.
shots.narration: 辅助气体把熔渣从切口吹走。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: sparks and a bright glow behind the protective window of the enclosure, an operator watching from outside. No text.
shots.narration: 火花四溅温度极高，只隔防护窗看。

shots.section_title: 切割头、压力表与格栅台
shots.scene: 【实拍】停机状态认识切割头和气压表
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the cutting head and the assist gas pressure gauge of an industrial laser cutter that is stopped and locked out.
shots.narration: 停机时认识切割头和辅助气压力表。
overlay: 切割头、压力表与格栅台

shots.section_title: 切割头、压力表与格栅台
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a metal sheet on a slatted grid table, slag falling into the space below. No text.
shots.narration: 板材放格栅台，下面留排渣空间。

shots.section_title: 切割头、压力表与格栅台
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: bellows covers protecting the guide rails from sparks and debris. No text.
shots.narration: 风琴罩护着导轨，挡火花和碎渣。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser marking a code onto a metal part, a traceability chain icon. No text.
shots.narration: 零件上打标编号，以后好追溯。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: finished parts stacked by batch beside a drawing, a checklist being ticked. No text.
shots.narration: 成品按批码放，对照图纸检查。

shots.scene: 查文件、选材料厚度、先试切
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a file check icon, a material and thickness icon and a small test grid, in sequence. No text.
shots.narration: 查文件，选对材料厚度，先试切。

shots.scene: 放平测准、先开排烟、关盖看守
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flat board with pins, a purifier icon, a closed lid and a watching eye icon. No text.
shots.narration: 放平测准，先开排烟，关盖看守。

shots.scene: 冷却取件清理；工业机隔窗看
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cooled badge lifted by tweezers, and an industrial cutter seen through a protective window. No text.
shots.narration: 冷却取件清理；工业机隔防护窗看。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在未拆封的焊机包装箱和机架旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an unopened shipping crate of a handheld laser welder and a flat packed machine stand, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：激光焊机与切割机架的安装。
